answer: Witnessed Attention Clock. Each identity must periodically answer random micro-challenges tied to a live event stream (e.g., a comet observation window) within a short deadline; answers only count if signed during that window, so parallel identities cannot time-share one operator's attention. Missed windows raise a kernel of accumulated delay that gates future task access. An attacker pays sustained, wall-clock-bound attention per identity, and idle Sybils drift out with the tide.
